tools.name: get_contact_details
tools.description: Get Michael Mester's phone number, WhatsApp link, email and office address, so the user can arrange a viewing or list a property. Does not send anything.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search Michael Mester's articles and video guides (Hebrew) about selling, buying, renting and investing in property in Ashkelon. Returns up to 5 titles with a short summary and the page URL.

query.description: The topic in Hebrew or English, e.g. 'exclusivity agreement' or 'מסמכים למכירת דירה'.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search the properties Michael Mester (RE/MAX Lekulam) is marketing in and around Ashkelon, Israel: homes for sale, rentals, commercial property and land. Returns up to 8 matches with asking price in ILS (per_month marks a rental), rooms, floor, neighborhood and page URL.

query.description: Free text in Hebrew or English, e.g. a neighborhood, street or feature.

deal.description: Buy or rent. rent includes commercial property for rent.

type.description: Category: homes for sale, homes for rent, commercial, land.

min_rooms.description: Minimum rooms, Israeli count (bedrooms plus living room: 3 bedrooms = 4 rooms).

max_price.description: Maximum price in ILS (monthly rent for rentals).
